verdict.rationale: Both protocols Stripe speaks are published openly. ACP is described as open source under Apache 2.0, and businesses can implement the specification with any agent or processor. MPP's full spec, including governance, is served to a plain unauthenticated GET at mpp.dev, and a community member notes it was submitted to the IETF. The gating that does exist (ChatGPT merchant application, OCA agreements, ACS waitlist) applies to Stripe's product and partner listings, not to reading or implementing the spec. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the specs are versioned (only the mppx SDK version 0.9.3 is shown), and independent hands-on reports of third parties implementing ACP from the spec alone.
